question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**instantly**" means immediately or without any delay.
 
• In the context of the sentence, "He **instantly** jumped up" means that the person reacted quickly and without any hesitation.
 
• The other options: "**gracefully**", "**tardily**", and "**constantly**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** I thought he would be glad if I came upon him with his breakfast, in that unexpected manner, so I went forth softly and touched him on the shoulder. He instantly__ jumped up, and it was not the same man, but another man!

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Gracefully (शालीनता से)**: means in an elegant and stylish manner.
 
• **Tardily (धीरे से)**: means in a delayed or slow manner.
 
• **Constantly (निरंतर)**: means continuously over a period of time.
